summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with experience building multi-agent AI pipelines and LLM-integrated production systems. Designed a distributed agentic architecture orchestrating LLM intent classification, real-time API communication, and autonomous inference — resolving 11 integration failures to achieve 100% task reliability across 10 trials.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free document understanding transformer) on a custom dataset for structured text extraction using PyTorch.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines to standardize evaluation workflows across model variants.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via preprocessing improvements and model tuning.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and monocular depth estimation — designed for reliable production deployment.
Deployed ZoeDepth for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Designed a three-layer multi-agent pipeline — Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO orchestration server, Jetson inference node — coordinated via a unified WebSocket fabric.
Integrated Gemini LLM for intent classification (<500ms), faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), and TensorRT YOLO at ~18 FPS into a single agentic workflow.
Resolved 11 integration failures; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s voice-to-action latency.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a full GPT-2 Transformer in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, weight tying, TikToken tokenizer, and custom training loop.
Validated text generation and model convergence via perplexity evaluation and early stopping.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced TinyLlama 1.1B memory footprint by ~25% via structured pruning and 8-bit quantization; benchmarked on HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC.
Quantified production LLM trade-offs: ~7% accuracy drop and +6.3 perplexity increase under aggressive compression.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built end-to-end ASR pipeline: 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder + 6-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention, achieving training loss ~0.51 on 1,000 Indian-English samples.
Designed Cython-accelerated BPE tokenizer achieving 4–5.5× speedup over pure Python; 15% WER on Hindi-English test set.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
